summary.purpose: Extracts monoline incurred losses, financial recovery details, claim representative assignments, and TFG transaction code mapping from ClaimCenter source views, aggregating to a summary of incurred losses by policy and line of business.
summary.high_level_narrative: The script declares start and end date parameters, then executes a multi-layered query. The innermost query joins core ClaimCenter entities (transaction line items, transactions, transaction sets, claims, policies, checks, reserve lines, exposures, coverages, contacts, users, risk units, class codes) and numerous type-code lookup views. It computes a row number for reserve lines per claim/exposure/type/cost, classifies policy source (Legacy vs Guidewire), assigns claim representatives based on state code and subrogation role, maps underwriting company names to codes, formats dates to YYYYMMDD, derives TFG transaction codes via a complex CASE expression driven by transaction type, cost type, reserve erosion flag, and recovery category, determines TFGASL/GWASL coverage codes, calculates an accounting date as the later of line creation and transaction set approval, adjusts transaction amounts (payments negative when eroding reserves, recoveries always negative, reserves positive), formats amounts as signed 12-character strings, and includes deductible formatting for specific EPLI coverages. The middle query applies a secondary TFGTran override for code '431' based on row number and cost type. The outermost query aggregates distinct PolSource, LOBCode, PolicyNumber summing TransAmount as IncurredAmount.
key_transformations: Row numbering for reserve lines partitioned by claim, exposure, transaction type, cost type ordered by create time
Policy source classification: 'Legacy' when PolicyPrefix_Ext is null else 'Guidewire'
ClaimRep1 assignment: Indiana (state '13') uses InRepID_ext, others use OhRepID_ext
ClaimRep2 assignment: SubroRepresentative_Ext mapped to SubroRepId_Ext or '00000'
Company code mapping: Lightning Rod -> 'LRM', Western Reserve -> 'WRM', Sonnenberg -> 'SON', else 'UNK'
Date formatting to CHAR(8) YYYYMMDD for OrigEffectiveDate, EffectiveDate, ExpirationDate, CloseDate, ReOpenDate, ApprovalDate, IssueDate

TFGTran code derivation: 431/432 for reserves, 321/331/322/332 for payments (depending on DoesNotErodeReserves and cost type), 321/322/341/342/351/353 for recoveries (depending on recovery category and cost type)
Secondary TFGTran override for '431': first indemnity reserve line becomes '421', subsequent '431'; first non-indemnity becomes '422', subsequent '432'
TFGASL/GWASL coverage mapping based on coverage type code and loss cause code
Accounting date = CASE WHEN tl.CreateTime >= tset.ApprovalDate THEN tl.CreateTime ELSE tset.ApprovalDate END

Transaction amount sign logic: Payment with DoesNotErodeReserves=0 => -TransactionAmount; Payment with DoesNotErodeReserves=1 => +TransactionAmount; Recovery => -TransactionAmount; Reserve => +TransactionAmount
Amount formatting: signed 12-char string with leading zeros, negative sign prefixed for negative values
Deductible formatting for BP7EmploymentPracticesLiabilityInsurance and BP7SupplementalExtendReportingPeriodEPLI: capped at 99999, left-padded
business_rules: Reserve lines are sequenced per claim/exposure/type/cost to identify first vs subsequent lines for TFGTran override.
Claim representative assignment differs for Indiana (state code '13') versus other states.
Subrogation representative defaults to '00000' when not assigned.
Underwriting company names map to three known codes; all others become 'UNK'.

TFGTran codes follow a strict matrix: transaction type (Reserve, Payment, Recovery) x cost type (Indemnity vs non-Indemnity) x DoesNotErodeReserves flag x recovery category (credit_loss, credit_exp, deductible, salvage, subro, etc.).
For transaction type 'Recovery', amount is always negative (recovery reduces incurred).
For transaction type 'Payment', amount is negative only when DoesNotErodeReserves = 0 (i.e., payment erodes reserves).
Accounting date uses the later of transaction line creation and transaction set approval, defaulting approval to '01/01/2000' when null.
TFGASL and GWASL codes differentiate between equipment breakdown ('270'), inland marine ('010'), and other ('021') based on coverage type and loss cause.
Deductible amounts for specific EPLI coverages are capped at 99999 and formatted as CHAR(10).

knowledge_profile.purpose: Extracts monoline incurred losses, financial recovery details, claim representative assignments, and TFG transaction code mapping from ClaimCenter views. Produces a summary of incurred losses by policy and line of business (LOB) for a specified date range.
key_logic: Declare start and end date parameters for filtering (though not visibly used in truncated snippet).
Innermost query joins 15+ ClaimCenter views to assemble transaction line items with claim, policy, exposure, coverage, user, and type code details.

Compute derived columns: PolSource (Legacy/Guidewire), rownum (ROW_NUMBER partition for reserves), ClaimNumber, PolicyType, LOBCode, PolicyType2, ClaimState, PolicyState, ClaimRep1 (state-dependent rep ID), ClaimRep2 (subro rep), PolicyNumber, PolicyDec, Company (mapped from underwriting company name), policy effective/expiration dates (formatted YYYYMMDD), ReportedDate, LossDate, CauseOfLoss (uppercased), TFGCov, TFGASL (coverage-based), GWASL (loss-cause-based), TLICreate, ApprovalDate (default 01/01/2000), ScheduledSendDate, AcctDate_sql (later of CreateTime and ApprovalDate), AcctDate (formatted), Producer, ClmtNumber, Class, DoesNotErodeReserves, coverage IDs, TFGTran (complex transaction code mapping), RecoveryCat, CoveragePatternCode, CoverageTypeCode, CovSubType, TranCode, CostType, ExpCode (cost category/line category logic), CheckNumber, IssueDate, ReinCo, ReinsAmt, TransAmount (signed amount per transaction type and reserve erosion), Amount (formatted string with sign and zero-padding), and various IDs.
Middle query reformats ClmtNumber (3-digit zero-padded), Class (8-digit zero-padded), and adjusts TFGTran based on rownum and CostType (e.g., first indemnity reserve becomes '421', subsequent '431').
Outer query groups by PolSource, LOBCode, PolicyNumber and sums TransAmount to produce IncurredAmount.

entities.description: End date parameter for reporting period.

entities.description: Users for claim reps (aliased as u1, u2).

entities.description: Line of business type codes (aliased as lob).

entities.name: vw_curr_cctl_losscause
entities.description: Loss cause type codes (aliased as tlc).

entities.name: TransAmount
entities.description: Signed transaction amount based on transaction type and reserve erosion flag.

transformations.description: Determine PolSource: 'Legacy' if PolicyPrefix_Ext is NULL else 'Guidewire'.
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN po.PolicyPrefix_Ext IS NULL THEN 'Legacy' ELSE 'Guidewire' END

transformations.description: Assign row number for reserve transactions partitioned by ClaimNumber, exposure id, transaction type, cost type ordered by CreateTime.
transformations.expression: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cl.ClaimNumber, ex.id, tt.TYPECODE, CST.NAME ORDER BY tl.CreateTime)

transformations.description: ClaimRep1: if ClaimState (first 2 chars of ProducerCode) = '13' use u1.InRepID_ext else u1.OhRepID_ext, default '00000'.
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN LEFT(cl.ProducerCode,2)='13' THEN LEFT(ISNULL(u1.InRepID_ext,'00000'),5) ELSE LEFT(ISNULL(u1.OhRepID_ext,'00000'),5) END

transformations.description: ClaimRep2: if SubroRepresentative_Ext is NULL then '00000' else left 5 chars of u2.SubroRepId_Ext.
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN cl.SubroRepresentative_Ext IS NULL THEN '00000' ELSE ISNULL(LEFT(u2.SubroRepId_Ext,5),'00000') END

transformations.description: Map underwriting company name to company code: LRM, WRM, SON, else UNK.
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN uw.name='Lightning Rod Mutual Insurance Company' THEN 'LRM' WHEN uw.name='Western Reserve Mutual Casualty Company' THEN 'WRM' WHEN uw.name='Sonnenberg Mutual Insurance Company' THEN 'SON' ELSE 'UNK' END

transformations.description: Format dates as YYYYMMDD strings using CONVERT and REPLACE.
transformations.expression: CAST(REPLACE(CONVERT(char(10), date_col, 101), '/', '') AS CHAR(8))

transformations.description: TFGASL mapping based on coverage type and CicsClaimCov_Ext.
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN ct.typecode IN ('CPEquipBrkCov') THEN '270' WHEN ct.typecode IN ('CPINCCCov') THEN '010' WHEN cv.CicsClaimCov_Ext IN ('615','616','617','618') THEN '010' ELSE '021' END

transformations.description: GWASL mapping based on coverage type and loss cause type code.
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN ct.typecode IN ('CPEquipBrkCov') THEN '270' WHEN ct.typecode IN ('CPINCCCov') THEN '010' WHEN tlc.TYPECODE IN ('fire','fire-wood_coal-stove','ightning','vandalism','explosion','sprinkler','sprinkler_leakage') THEN '010' ELSE '021' END

transformations.description: AcctDate_sql: later of tl.CreateTime and tset.ApprovalDate (default 01/01/2000).
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN tl.CreateTime >= ISNULL(tset.ApprovalDate,'01/01/2000') THEN CAST(tl.CreateTime AS date) ELSE CAST(tset.approvaldate AS date) END

transformations.description: TFGTran mapping: complex rules for Reserve, Payment, Recovery transaction types with cost type, DoesNotErodeReserves, and recovery category.
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Reserve' AND cst.NAME='Indemnity' THEN '431' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Reserve' AND cst.NAME<>'Indemnity' THEN '432' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Payment' AND cst.NAME='Indemnity' AND t.DoesNotErodeReserves=1 THEN '321' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Payment' AND cst.NAME='Indemnity' AND t.DoesNotErodeReserves<>1 THEN '331' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Payment' AND cst.NAME<>'Indemnity' AND t.DoesNotErodeReserves=1 THEN '322' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Payment' AND cst.NAME<>'Indemnity' AND t.DoesNotErodeReserves<>1 THEN '332' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' AND rv.TypeCode='Credit_loss' AND cst.NAME='Indemnity' THEN '321' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' AND rv.TYPECODE='Credit_loss' AND cst.NAME<>'Indemnity' THEN '322' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' AND cst.NAME='EXPENSE - OTHERS' THEN '322' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' AND rv.TYPECODE='credit_exp' THEN '322' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' AND rv.TYPECODE='deductible' THEN '321' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' AND rv.TYPECODE='salvage' AND cst.NAME='Indemnity' THEN '341' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' AND rv.TYPECODE='salvage' AND cst.NAME<>'Indemnity' THEN '342' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' AND rv.TYPECODE='subro' AND cst.NAME='Indemnity' THEN '351' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' AND rv.TYPECODE='subro' AND cst.NAME<>'Indemnity' THEN '353' ELSE 'XXX' END

transformations.description: ExpCode derivation based on cost type, cost category, line category.
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN CST.NAME='Indemnity' THEN ' ' WHEN ccat.TYPECODE IN ('legalexpense_ext','appraisal_ext') THEN UPPER(CAST(ccat.TYPECODE AS char(45))) WHEN lc.TYPECODE IN ('deductible','formerdeductible') THEN UPPER(CAST(ccat.TYPECODE AS char(45))) WHEN lc.TYPECODE IS NOT NULL THEN UPPER(CAST(lc.TYPECODE AS char(45))) WHEN lc.TYPECODE IS NULL AND ccat.TYPECODE='autoparts' THEN 'OTHER' ELSE UPPER(CAST(ccat.TYPECODE AS char(45))) END

transformations.description: TransAmount sign logic: Payments with DoesNotErodeReserves=0 are negative; Recoveries negative; else positive.
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Payment' THEN CASE WHEN t.DoesNotErodeReserves=0 THEN ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0)*-1 ELSE tl.TransactionAmount END WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' THEN ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0)*-1 ELSE ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0) END

transformations.description: Amount formatting: complex string formatting for positive/negative numbers with leading zeros and sign character.
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' THEN CASE WHEN ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0)>0 THEN CONCAT('-', RIGHT(CAST((-100000000 + ISNULL(-1*tl.TransactionAmount,0)) AS numeric(11,2)),11)) ELSE RIGHT(CONCAT('00000000', CAST(ISNULL(-1*tl.TransactionAmount,0) AS numeric(11,2))),12) END ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0)<0 THEN CONCAT('-', RIGHT(CAST((-100000000 + ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0)) AS numeric(11,2)),11)) ELSE RIGHT(CONCAT('00000000', CAST(ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0) AS numeric(11,2))),12) END END

transformations.description: Middle query TFGTran adjustment: for TFGTran='431' and CostType='Indemnity', first row (rownum=1) becomes '421', others stay '431'; for non-Indemnity, first row becomes '422', others '432'.
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN TFGTran='431' AND CostType='Indemnity' AND rownum=1 THEN '421' WHEN TFGTran='431' AND CostType='Indemnity' AND rownum<>1 THEN '431' WHEN TFGTran='431' AND CostType<>'Indemnity' AND rownum=1 THEN '422' WHEN TFGTran='431' AND CostType<>'Indemnity' AND rownum<>1 THEN '432' ELSE TFGTran END

transformations.description: Outer query aggregates TransAmount by PolSource, LOBCode, PolicyNumber to produce IncurredAmount.
transformations.expression: SUM(TransAmount)

properties.description: ClaimRep2: if SubroRepresentative_Ext is NULL then '00000' else left 5 chars of u2.SubroRepId_Ext.
properties.expression: CASE WHEN cl.SubroRepresentative_Ext IS NULL THEN '00000' ELSE ISNULL(LEFT(u2.SubroRepId_Ext,5),'00000') END

properties.description: Map underwriting company name to company code: LRM, WRM, SON, else UNK.
properties.expression: CASE WHEN uw.name='Lightning Rod Mutual Insurance Company' THEN 'LRM' WHEN uw.name='Western Reserve Mutual Casualty Company' THEN 'WRM' WHEN uw.name='Sonnenberg Mutual Insurance Company' THEN 'SON' ELSE 'UNK' END

properties.description: Format dates as YYYYMMDD strings using CONVERT and REPLACE.
TFGASL mapping based on coverage type and CicsClaimCov_Ext.
properties.expression: CASE WHEN ct.typecode IN ('CPEquipBrkCov') THEN '270' WHEN ct.typecode IN ('CPINCCCov') THEN '010' WHEN cv.CicsClaimCov_Ext IN ('615','616','617','618') THEN '010' ELSE '021' END

properties.description: GWASL mapping based on coverage type and loss cause type code.
properties.expression: CASE WHEN ct.typecode IN ('CPEquipBrkCov') THEN '270' WHEN ct.typecode IN ('CPINCCCov') THEN '010' WHEN tlc.TYPECODE IN ('fire','fire-wood_coal-stove','ightning','vandalism','explosion','sprinkler','sprinkler_leakage') THEN '010' ELSE '021' END

properties.description: AcctDate_sql: later of tl.CreateTime and tset.ApprovalDate (default 01/01/2000).
properties.expression: CASE WHEN tl.CreateTime >= ISNULL(tset.ApprovalDate,'01/01/2000') THEN CAST(tl.CreateTime AS date) ELSE CAST(tset.approvaldate AS date) END

properties.description: TFGTran mapping: complex rules for Reserve, Payment, Recovery transaction types with cost type, DoesNotErodeReserves, and recovery category.
properties.expression: CASE WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Reserve' AND cst.NAME='Indemnity' THEN '431' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Reserve' AND cst.NAME<>'Indemnity' THEN '432' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Payment' AND cst.NAME='Indemnity' AND t.DoesNotErodeReserves=1 THEN '321' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Payment' AND cst.NAME='Indemnity' AND t.DoesNotErodeReserves<>1 THEN '331' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Payment' AND cst.NAME<>'Indemnity' AND t.DoesNotErodeReserves=1 THEN '322' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Payment' AND cst.NAME<>'Indemnity' AND t.DoesNotErodeReserves<>1 THEN '332' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' AND rv.TypeCode='Credit_loss' AND cst.NAME='Indemnity' THEN '321' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' AND rv.TYPECODE='Credit_loss' AND cst.NAME<>'Indemnity' THEN '322' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' AND cst.NAME='EXPENSE - OTHERS' THEN '322' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' AND rv.TYPECODE='credit_exp' THEN '322' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' AND rv.TYPECODE='deductible' THEN '321' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' AND rv.TYPECODE='salvage' AND cst.NAME='Indemnity' THEN '341' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' AND rv.TYPECODE='salvage' AND cst.NAME<>'Indemnity' THEN '342' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' AND rv.TYPECODE='subro' AND cst.NAME='Indemnity' THEN '351' WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' AND rv.TYPECODE='subro' AND cst.NAME<>'Indemnity' THEN '353' ELSE 'XXX' END

properties.description: ExpCode derivation based on cost type, cost category, line category.
properties.expression: CASE WHEN CST.NAME='Indemnity' THEN ' ' WHEN ccat.TYPECODE IN ('legalexpense_ext','appraisal_ext') THEN UPPER(CAST(ccat.TYPECODE AS char(45))) WHEN lc.TYPECODE IN ('deductible','formerdeductible') THEN UPPER(CAST(ccat.TYPECODE AS char(45))) WHEN lc.TYPECODE IS NOT NULL THEN UPPER(CAST(lc.TYPECODE AS char(45))) WHEN lc.TYPECODE IS NULL AND ccat.TYPECODE='autoparts' THEN 'OTHER' ELSE UPPER(CAST(ccat.TYPECODE AS char(45))) END

properties.description: TransAmount sign logic: Payments with DoesNotErodeReserves=0 are negative; Recoveries negative; else positive.
properties.expression: CASE WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Payment' THEN CASE WHEN t.DoesNotErodeReserves=0 THEN ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0)*-1 ELSE tl.TransactionAmount END WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' THEN ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0)*-1 ELSE ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0) END

properties.description: Amount formatting: complex string formatting for positive/negative numbers with leading zeros and sign character.
properties.expression: CASE WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' THEN CASE WHEN ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0)>0 THEN CONCAT('-', RIGHT(CAST((-100000000 + ISNULL(-1*tl.TransactionAmount,0)) AS numeric(11,2)),11)) ELSE RIGHT(CONCAT('00000000', CAST(ISNULL(-1*tl.TransactionAmount,0) AS numeric(11,2))),12) END ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0)<0 THEN CONCAT('-', RIGHT(CAST((-100000000 + ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0)) AS numeric(11,2)),11)) ELSE RIGHT(CONCAT('00000000', CAST(ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0) AS numeric(11,2))),12) END END

properties.description: Middle query TFGTran adjustment: for TFGTran='431' and CostType='Indemnity', first row (rownum=1) becomes '421', others stay '431'; for non-Indemnity, first row becomes '422', others '432'.
properties.expression: CASE WHEN TFGTran='431' AND CostType='Indemnity' AND rownum=1 THEN '421' WHEN TFGTran='431' AND CostType='Indemnity' AND rownum<>1 THEN '431' WHEN TFGTran='431' AND CostType<>'Indemnity' AND rownum=1 THEN '422' WHEN TFGTran='431' AND CostType<>'Indemnity' AND rownum<>1 THEN '432' ELSE TFGTran END

properties.description: Outer query aggregates TransAmount by PolSource, LOBCode, PolicyNumber to produce IncurredAmount.
GROUP BY PolSource, LOBCode, PolicyNumber SUM(TransAmount) AS IncurredAmount
